$comment: BC Transit: the operator of the bc-transit-* feeds (config/feeds/), each one or more of its transit systems around BC. No overrides of the defaults (config/defaults/) yet: its buses are taken as standard 12 m buses (Kelowna has no articulated buses: config/feeds/bc-transit-kelowna/README.md → Buses; the Fraser Valley's: config/feeds/bc-transit-fraser-valley/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #4), and prediction uses the defaults, untested on its data (config/feeds/bc-transit-victoria/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md #3).
$realtimePoll: How often its feeds are polled is each feed's own (feed.json → realtime.poll). Only Victoria and Kelowna, the biggest systems, are polled more often than every 2 minutes: positions every 30 s (Braden MacDonald, 2026-11-01). Feeds with a bigger town (the Fraser Valley, Vancouver Island, Thompson–Cariboo, Okanagan–Shuswap, Northern BC) poll positions and trip updates every 2 minutes while buses run, 5 overnight, and alerts every 5 minutes, 15 overnight: about 1,500 requests a day under a cap of 2,000 (config/feeds/bc-transit-fraser-valley/feed.json). Small systems (Sea to Sky, Sunshine Coast, Kootenays) don't need frequent polling: every 5 minutes, 10 overnight, alerts every 15, about 610 a day under a cap of 1,000 (config/feeds/bc-transit-kootenays/feed.json) (Braden MacDonald, 2026-11-02).
